questions.answer: Fixture builds reusable setup/teardown: setup code runs, yield hands the value to the test, code after yield cleans up. Inject by naming the fixture as a test parameter.
questions.question: What is a pytest fixture and how does yield provide teardown?

questions.answer: Unit tests one function in isolation with mocked deps (fast, milliseconds). Integration wires route+DB+response together (slower, fewer). Pyramid: many unit, few integration.
questions.question: Unit vs integration testing?

questions.answer: TestClient runs FastAPI in-process without a server (sync simplicity). httpx ASGITransport does the same for async tests. Both assert status + JSON shape.

questions.answer: Mocks must patch where the name is used (myapp.send_email), not where it was defined. Patching the definition leaves the already-imported reference unmocked.

questions.answer: Coverage shows untested lines, not correctness. 80%+ with 100% on critical paths is the gate; blindly chasing 100% tests lines instead of behavior.
